summary.text: Brian Buchanan is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 7, serving since 2018.
The caucus page lists Buchanan as chair of the Commerce and Technology Committee and ranking member of the Utilities Committee.

paragraphs.text: Buchanan holds a B.S. in agricultural education from Purdue University, and the page lists Buchanan as a board member of AgriInstitute and a mentor in the Boone County Mentorship Program.
He represents Clinton County and portions of Boone, Hendricks and Montgomery counties, and the page also lists service on the Education and Career Development and Tax and Fiscal Policy committees.
